items.title: In-person appointment for residence permit extension
items.quote: zur Bearbeitung Ihres Antrags vom 01.09.2026 laden wir Sie zur persönlichen Vorsprache ein am Donnerstag, den 15.10.2026, um 10:45 Uhr, Haus B, Wartebereich 2.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date and time for the appointment: Thursday, 15.10.2026, 10:45, Haus B, Wartebereich 2. No period calculation is needed; the appointment date is taken as printed.

warnings: This is an invitation to an appointment, not a decision on the residence permit itself; no Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung (legal remedy instructions) is given because none is required for an invitation to appear.

Bring the listed documents (passport, current employer certificate, rental contract, biometric photo) to the appointment; the letter notes the Fiktionsbescheinigung remains valid until a decision is made.
